issues_detected.description: Purpose cites a 'publicly available' dataset while access is controlled; the record correctly marks the grant abstract as future-tense plans.

semantic_insights: Funding is precise and internally consistent: grantor NIH, award OT2OD032701 with FY2022 project number 1OT2OD032701-01, project dates 2022-09-01 to 2026-11-30.
Source conflicts and future-tense grant statements are explicitly caveated rather than silently resolved.
OMOP/DICOM/WFDB conformance is tied to specific modalities.

recommendations: Add ethics review, consent/waiver and de-identification method documentation.
Mint a DOI and provide a citation; add version and update plan.
Name the data use agreement, hosting enclave and distribution formats.
Add a data dictionary, cohort demographics, limitations and bias documentation.
